title: Surfactant-mediated mesoscopic confinement and selective interfacial shielding for highly stable zinc anode
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, 19,1385-1392
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE06338H, Paper
Zhenhai Shi, Suli Chen, Min Zan, Leiqian Zhang, Jiaming Gong, Yazhou Zhou, Klaus Müllen, Feili Lai, Tianxi Liu
A surfactant-mediated mesoscopic electrolyte strategy was proposed to stabilize the Zn anodes by introducing an amphipathic SL-surfactant, which enables simultaneous regulation of Zn2+ solvation structure and interfacial deposition behavior.
